Registry Entry
The relation named **(Fictional Reference World, Registry Entry)** refers to a registry entry that is situated within and describes the fictional reference world. The entry records and describes the stated relationship that exists in the current fictional reference world, indicating that it is both located inside that world and provides information about the relationships within it.<SEP>Registry Entry is situated within the Fictional Reference World.<SEP>The registry entry describes the stated relationship in the fictional reference world.

assertion,asserts,contained_in,contains,describes,originates from,recording,records	Registry Entry
Source Assertion
The relation (Registry Entry, Source Assertion) specifies that a registry entry serves as a container for a source assertion. In this relationship, the registry entry records or holds the source assertion, and this act of recording is performed independently of any evaluation of other registry entries. The source assertion is thus contained within the registry entry, which records it without assessing additional entries.<SEP>The registry entry records a source assertion without evaluating other registry entries.<SEP>Registry Entry records the source assertion.<SEP>Registry Entry records the Source Assertion.<SEP>The registry entry records a source assertion.

context,contextualizes,describes,describes in,describes_in,located in,occurs_in,references	Current Fictional Reference World
Registry Entry
The **Registry Entry** is a construct that exists within the **Current Fictional Reference World**. It serves to describe and document the relationships that occur in that world, providing a structured account of how entities interact and are situated within the setting. The entry also offers a description of the world’s setting itself, thereby contextualizing the relationships it records. In essence, the Registry Entry functions as a comprehensive reference point that both locates itself within the fictional world and supplies detailed information about the world’s relational dynamics.<SEP>The registry entry describes the stated relationship in the current fictional reference world.<SEP>The registry entry records that the current fictional reference world is part of the described relationship.<SEP>Registry Entry describes the relationship within the current fictional reference world.
